name: MagicX XU20

pad.note: simplepad, a UART MCU pad (see Zero28). The capture is the stock MagicX image (2026-09-21), before oakMOSS.

touch.note: Hynitron hyn_ts (OAKMOSS_TOUCH_MODULE=hynitron); not autoloaded, device_init's oakmoss_load_touch loads it once the board has settled

MENU.note: the cfg is conditional: on an image that still carries MagicX's second codes (OAKMOSS_PAD_RIDERS=1, detected from the pad's key-capability bits at boot) MENU is 256 instead, because 158 is then B's second code and 353 rides on A; oakMOSS images from 2026-09-26 drop the riders, so 158 is the current default
MENU.cfg_differs: XU20.cfg sets B_MENU at runtime (1 256 with OAKMOSS_PAD_RIDERS=1, else 1 158); the static read sees no value. 1 158 is current oakMOSS

HOME.note: KEY_HOMEPAGE, the XU20's extra face button (G/switch-key, PH11 then PH14 across image generations); conditional on the pad reporting key 172 in its capability bits at boot - cfg exports DOESNT_EXIST when that bit is absent (older images gave this physical key no code at all). The 2026-09-21 stock-image capture (predates this logic) shows a BTN_G GPIO edge firing once, consistent with a real, reachable button on this board, unlike the Zero 28/Zero 40's unused BTN_G pin. device_home_button_pressed in XU20.sh runs the configured Home action on it.
HOME.cfg_differs: XU20.cfg sets B_HOME at runtime: 1 172 when the pad declares key 172, else DOESNT_EXIST; the static read sees the else branch

absent.L3: the cfg exports B_L3="1 317" (the shared MagicX simplepad block, 'also logs left fnkey stuff'), but DEVICE_NUM_ANALOG_STICKS=0 and the task's own framing states the XU20 has no analog sticks despite the cfg listing L3/R3; the 2026-09-21 capture's GPIO table has no THUMB_L/THUMB_R lines, and the cfg's own SDL_GAMECONTROLLERCONFIG binds no leftstick/rightstick/L3/R3 for this board. There is no stick to click.
absent.R3: see L3: cfg exports B_R3="1 318" from the shared block, but there is no physical stick/click on this board (DEVICE_NUM_ANALOG_STICKS=0; no SDL bind; no measured GPIO edge)
absent.LEFT_STICK: 0 sticks (DEVICE_NUM_ANALOG_STICKS=0; simplepad reports joysticks=<0x0>); STICK_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN are blank in the cfg
absent.RIGHT_STICK: 0 sticks; STICK_LEFT_2/RIGHT_2/UP_2/DOWN_2 are blank in the cfg
absent.FN_SWITCH: no switch; device_get_switch_position is the oakMOSS no-op stub on MagicX boards (oakmoss_a133p.sh: the TrimUI PH19 pin is L1 here)
absent.FN_LEFT: no Fn key separate from L3/R3 (which are themselves absent here); none declared
absent.FN_RIGHT: no Fn key separate from L3/R3 (which are themselves absent here); none declared
absent.LID: no lid; not a clamshell, no hall node in this board's tree

notes: The 2026-09-21 discovery capture is the stock MagicX image, before oakMOSS; node names are expected to carry over by name match (magicx-input, axp2202-pek) but have not been re-measured on an oakMOSS build.

A hardware run on a current oakMOSS image should confirm HOME fires 1 172 (not DOESNT_EXIST) and MENU is 158, not 256 - both depend on the pad's reported key-capability bits, which this task did not probe directly.
